body:
XL original-model progress — ROOT checkpoint, 13 October 2026.

Fixed scope: **521 = 234 installed + 287 remaining**. This checkpoint adds **zero installations**. No AI geometry modelling or optimisation assets were produced.

**Upton:** saved boundary attribution completed in pinned Neon job `99e1e9daa5bde8286df4224360ab17934044b87d13226d7491e8700ca4860b6a`. ROOT independently verified all **9,516** evidence references, unchanged current inputs, released reservations and absent producer processes. Committed/pushed `ac9c8dbdd62cb0a0d0027e17f6ae986a87f5117c`. All **100 interval + 257 area** failure rows remain recorded. Every saved interval midpoint is inside an ideal fragment but outside the selected packed fragments; matching full-edge endpoints already agree. This supports investigation of subdivision boundaries, not installation acceptance. The 257 area rows remain unresolved. The next bounded, source-only investigation preserves all 68 whole-current protected facets and excludes any protected incident family from proposed retessellation. Preparation and one conditional metadata run are authorised; no repair geometry is authorised.

**PolyU Sports Centre 305582:** fresh exact source/current-terrain capture completed in pinned Neon job `74fc230cb2ea65e352f2d47ec20440f455bc6ae428158ba68472ab528a37bf5e`. ROOT independently verified all **720** evidence references, full 10,536 facets in four arithmetic views, 21 provider-original components plus four zero faces, 12 current terrain facets and 13 canonical resources. Both reservation groups released; recorded producer processes absent; manifest `c00fd9f…` and 6,650 native catalogue entries unchanged. Committed/pushed `1ef146b853e41f6b9c95541777ebc0c87d8b6f17`. Native podium 305793 retains `publicationApproved:false`. Identity evidence does not grant physical acceptance. Next: actual local preparation and one conditional complete finite/grade worker; no authority transfers from the historical 235076/114494 pair.

**Citywalk:** source-context job `43fd031e415b5527e04304114689ef8d72cca6b19d1acc6e8484328598952197`, all 283 references, views and terminal audit are independently verified and pushed in `4ca716b2e` / `1fb761416`. Its unchanged bounded grade/cap worker remains active under PTY 53906. Original seed phase finished; bounded cap traversal and later tuples remain pending. Receipt-only recovery is prospective and unexecuted, subject to an actual terminal collision/release audit. Completed earlier full numerical job `9f7ed6da…` retains all raw ordinary/coverage failures; no installation credit.

**Southside:** the same maintained constructor remains active under PTY 94581, owned process 1019565 / supervisor 1019535, with advancing CPU time and heartbeat. No restart or completion claim.

Earlier independently verified evidence remains preserved: PolyU bounded identity `d912fa149`; Upton complete finite/union `37376b45d` and saved attribution `cb5643161`; Citywalk complete finite evidence `6f2d72c0e`. Upton's former incorrect 104/253 preparation/report aggregate is archived with an explicit erratum; the correct totals are 100/257. The failed preparation occurred before a lease or numerical worker, and corrected preparation did not change numerical geometry.

Continue original acquisition/placement work until each XL source is installed or genuinely source-specifically unfixable with evidence in Neon. ROOT remains sole publisher on the authorised non-main branch. No optimisation batch, derived asset publication, database migration/reset or acceptance-flag bypass is authorised.
